params.1273: Set your autocast spell to Wind Rush.
params.1292: Completing this Task will take you one step further in the Blood Pact quest.
params.1274: First, equip the staff you took from the mage; it will provide you with a source of air runes.
params.1275: Open your magic spellbook on your side bar.
params.1276: Click on the Wind Rush spell to set it as your attack.
params.1277: Any spell requires runes to cast. Wind Rush requires only two air runes, and your staff provides an unlimited supply of these.
